_comment: Email content for the latest release. Update this each release as part of /release-update, then run send.mjs. Keep it to the highlights; this is an email, not the full changelog. British English, no em dashes, no emojis, no permanence words.
subject: InnerZero 0.2.2 is out
preheader: Voice through a network Ollama server, speech models that download during setup, better GPU detection, sharper memory recall, and an Offline mode that covers network AI servers.
intro: Version 0.2.2 of InnerZero is now available. It brings voice to machines that lean on an Ollama server elsewhere on the network, makes the first-run setup and voice start honest about what they are doing, and tightens Offline mode. Here are the highlights.

groups.label: New
items: Voice on a network Ollama server: on the No Local Model tier, voice now works when you choose a voice-capable model that the connected Ollama server actually has, so a low-spec machine gets spoken conversation from another computer on your network.

Speech models download during setup: the first-run setup bar shows a third segment for the speech models with real progress, and the Voice page says when a first-time download is happening instead of sitting on Loading models.
The chat history notice explains that Zero still remembers what you talked about, and its close button snoozes it for seven days.

groups.label: Improved
items: Offline mode now blocks a network AI server too: with Offline on, nothing you say, nothing from memory and nothing else that carries your content reaches an Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp server on another machine, and the automatic Ollama status and keep-alive calls stop as well (a few plain is-the-server-up checks remain and are next on the list). Private mode with a network server is unchanged.

GPU detection on newer cards: detection gives the bundled runtime's start-up the time it needs (up to 90 seconds on Windows), Settings > Hardware says when detection is still running or did not complete instead of reporting CPU only, and the first-run check catches a model that landed on the CPU of a GPU machine.

Memory recall: what you said is matched more closely against what Zero remembers, a newer version of a fact outranks the older one, and the overnight memory pass reads your side of the conversation as well as Zero's.

groups.label: Fixed
items: If voice cannot start because no microphone could be opened or speech recognition did not load, the Voice page and the chat microphone now say so and return to a ready state instead of hanging.
/forget by id now works for every memory id, and a network Ollama address with no host name is rejected instead of being saved.
A failed model unload before the first-run GPU check no longer moves a healthy GPU machine to the CPU tier.
